cover.title: Edgar Meyer, Mike Marshall & George Meyer
cover.pressQuote: "At the intersection of bluegrass and classical music sits the school of virtuosity while professors Meyer/Marshall/Meyer are hard at work and play." JamBands.com

sections.title: Welcome
sections.quote: Edgar Meyer and Mike Marshall have been making music together for 20 years. Joined by George Meyer, this trio brings the informal, joyful spirit of bluegrass festival picking to the concert stage—casually virtuosic, played at the highest possible level.
body: Edgar Meyer and Mike Marshall have been making music together for 20 years: Bach duets, Brazilian choros, original compositions, and old-time fiddle tunes, all played with the easy authority of two masters who possess an inspiring control over their craft. Joined by George Meyer, an accomplished violinist and composer in his own right, this trio brings something special to the concert stage: the informal, joyful spirit of bluegrass festival picking. Experience the kind of music usually heard only backstage—casually virtuosic for old friends and, yes, family—played at the highest possible level.
